resources.string: OpenDrive Assistant
Talk, ask follow-up questions, search for a destination and control your music using OpenAI.

When you press the microphone, your recording, conversation and requested trip or music information are sent to OpenAI. Your personal API key is encrypted on this phone. API usage is billed to your OpenAI API account. This does not connect to your ChatGPT conversations.

Try “Navigate to Utrecht”, “Pause the music” or “Find Miles Davis in my music app”. Press the microphone for each follow-up; press again to send early. A short silence ends recording. Set up Car audio to hear answers through the car. When disabled, the assistant selected below is used.
